name: Triage
description: Direct firefighting crews across competing fire fronts under a strict action budget, saving as many lives as possible when there are never enough crews to hold every line.

binding_vow.description: A grid-based wildfire simulation. Several fire fronts ignite simultaneously across a map, each threatening a different population center. Each turn the agent commands every crew, spending a fixed pool of action points per crew on moving, suppressing fire, prepping firebreaks, and evacuating people. Crews are few and action points are scarce, so the agent must choose which fronts to hold and which to let burn. The benchmark measures how well a model triages scarce responders across competing fronts under that pressure.

observation_space.description: JSON object with fields: task (string instruction), format (example command JSON), turn (int), turns_left (int), grid ([width, height]), score (int running total), crews (array of {id, size, cell:[x,y], actions_remaining}), cells (sparse array of decision-relevant cells only). Each cell has x, y and optional fields: fire:1 (omitted when not burning), intensity (0-100, only when fire), spread (spreadability 0-100, omitted if default 50), pop (population, omitted if 0), prop (property remaining, omitted if 0). Only cells on fire, adjacent to fire, holding population, or holding a crew are included.

action_space.description: JSON object with a single key 'commands': an array of crew commands. Each command is an object with 'crew' (crew id int) and 'action' (one of 'move', 'suppress', 'prep', 'evacuate', 'split'). Move and evacuate also require 'to': [x, y] for the destination cell. Split requires 'size': N (integer, 0 < N < crew.size) and spawns a new independent crew at the same cell with N members; the parent loses those members. The new crew is visible in the next observation with a fresh id and full action points. Commands are processed in listed order; each costs 1 action point from that crew's pool. Illegal commands (non-adjacent move, suppressing a non-burning cell, split size out of range, exceeding action points, unknown crew id) are silently rejected and counted. Evacuated people accumulate at the destination cell — ferry people multiple steps to reach safety. Example: {"commands": [{"crew": 0, "action": "move", "to": [5, 5]}, {"crew": 0, "action": "suppress"}, {"crew": 1, "action": "evacuate", "to": [8, 9]}, {"crew": 1, "action": "split", "size": 5}]}

reward.description: Per-tick signed delta added to a running total, then normalized at episode end against scenario-specific do-nothing and greedy baselines. A norm_score of 0 matches doing nothing; 1.0 matches the greedy heuristic ceiling; above 1.0 means the agent beat greedy. Practical band is 0 to 1 for a competent agent.
